# Data Center Load (DataCenterLoad)

> **Class**: `DataCenterLoad` | **Module**: `energysim.models.loads` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Hyperscale AI / Cloud Data Center Electrical & Thermal Load.

Grid power = IT power x PUE(T_amb) with PUE from a lookup curve; 98 % of IT
power is assumed to appear as recoverable waste heat. Quasi-static (no
thermal inertia or workload dynamics). Validity: T_amb -10..40 C,
0 <= IT <= it_capacity_mw.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'DataCenter'` | - | - |
| `it_capacity_mw` | `float` | `100.0` | MW | Nominal IT compute server capacity in MW. |
| `base_pue` | `float` | `1.15` | - | Base Power Usage Effectiveness at mild ambient temperatures (<=15 C). |
| `pue_curve` | `Optional[Curve1D]` | `None` | - | PUE vs ambient dry-bulb temperature. |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_it_cmd_MW` | MW | - |
| `T_amb` | degC | Ambient wet/dry-bulb temperature |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_total_grid_MW` | MW | - |
| `P_it_MW` | MW | - |
| `P_cooling_MW` | MW | Active power consumed solely by chillers and HVAC |
| `PUE` | 1 | Operating Power Usage Effectiveness |
| `Q_waste_heat_MW` | MW | - |

## Validity and notes

*No validity range is documented for this model yet.*

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import DataCenterLoad

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('datacenterload', model=DataCenterLoad(), outputs=['P_total_grid_MW', 'P_it_MW', 'P_cooling_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['datacenterload'].tail(2))
```
